def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==2]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    from collections import defaultdict
    rows=defaultdict(list); cols=defaultdict(list)
    for r,c in pts: rows[r].append(c); cols[c].append(r)
    for r,cs in rows.items():
        if len(cs)==2:
            for c in range(min(cs)+1,max(cs)): out[r][c]=3
    for c,rs in cols.items():
        if len(rs)==2:
            for r in range(min(rs)+1,max(rs)): out[r][c]=3
    return out
